scope: Catalog package only; fictional messages and isolated Hermes runtime; no live Google grant or Gmail import.

checks.real_hermes_registry: 12 tools; catalog, account setup, synthetic prepare/start/status/verify/report passed
checks.real_hermes_oauth_boundary: installed worker reached credentialed_provider_request; missing grant returns human sign-in command without Google access
checks.transport: actual migration engine through JSON adapter, mocked Gmail service: lost acknowledgement with delayed search visibility; resumed without duplicate uploads; zero-import rerun
checks.profile_isolation: scoped POP secret beats another profile global value; unrelated secrets excluded; owning HERMES_HOME passed explicitly
checks.account_binding: exact identity verified before writes; every migration URL targets the frozen destination, not users/me
checks.tls_pop: real loopback TLS capture resumed 2,1,0 downloads; no DELE; local hashes verified
checks.credential_files: catalog profiles reject old OAuth client/token-file configuration; plugin implements no token store or browser OAuth worker

limitations: 25 MiB per prepared message in JSON transport
POP-visible mail only; folders/local archives need separate EML exports
direct IMAP and PST/MBOX parsing not implemented
publication: GitHub catalog candidate; listing requires maintainer review
ci: Linux Python 3.11 and 3.14 workflow provided; see GitHub Actions for its actual status
